files.textKm: [tired] ផ្លូវលិចទឹកអស់ហើយ។ [pause] មានគេចាំក្មួយនៅផ្ទះទេ?
files.subtitleEn: The road is flooded. Is someone expecting you?

files.textKm: [tired] ផ្លូវលិចទឹកអស់ហើយ។ [pause] មានគេចាំក្មួយនៅផ្ទះទេ?
files.subtitleEn: The road is flooded. Is someone expecting you?

files.textKm: [tired] [softly] ព្រឹកមិញ ពូទើបតែដឹកអ្នកមកបុណ្យខ្មោចទៅទីនោះ។
files.subtitleEn: I took mourners there this morning.

files.textKm: [tired] [softly] ព្រឹកមិញ ពូទើបតែដឹកអ្នកមកបុណ្យខ្មោចទៅទីនោះ។
files.subtitleEn: I took mourners there this morning.

files.textKm: [softly] ដើមឈើធំអស់ហើយ… [pause] តែផ្លូវនៅដដែល។
files.subtitleEn: The trees have grown. The road hasn't changed.

files.textKm: [softly] ដើមឈើធំអស់ហើយ… [pause] តែផ្លូវនៅដដែល។
files.subtitleEn: The trees have grown. The road hasn't changed.

files.textKm: [nervous] [softly] គ្មានអ្នកណាមកឈរចាំក្បែរផ្លូវនេះទេ… [pause] ពិសេសពេលភ្លៀងបែបនេះ។
files.subtitleEn: People don't wait beside this road. Not in this weather.

files.textKm: [nervous] [softly] គ្មានអ្នកណាមកឈរចាំក្បែរផ្លូវនេះទេ… [pause] ពិសេសពេលភ្លៀងបែបនេះ។
files.subtitleEn: People don't wait beside this road. Not in this weather.

files.textKm: [nervous] [softly] មើលតែទៅមុខទៅ… [whispers] កុំហៅវាអី។
files.subtitleEn: Keep your eyes forward. Don't call to it.

files.textKm: [nervous] [softly] មើលតែទៅមុខទៅ… [whispers] កុំហៅវាអី។
files.subtitleEn: Keep your eyes forward. Don't call to it.

files.textKm: [whispers] ល្អហើយ។ [pause] គ្របចង្កៀងទុកសិន ទាល់តែចេញផុត។
files.subtitleEn: Good. Keep your lamp covered until you're out.

files.textKm: [whispers] ល្អហើយ។ [pause] គ្របចង្កៀងទុកសិន ទាល់តែចេញផុត។
files.subtitleEn: Good. Keep your lamp covered until you're out.

files.textKm: [tired] [softly] ពូជូនបានត្រឹមនេះហើយ។ ដើរតាមផ្លូវនេះទៅរោងបុណ្យទៅ… [whispers] ហើយកុំនិយាយខ្លាំងៗ។
files.subtitleEn: This is as far as I go. Follow the path to the funeral tent. Stay quiet.

files.textKm: [tired] [softly] ពូជូនបានត្រឹមនេះហើយ។ ដើរតាមផ្លូវនេះទៅរោងបុណ្យទៅ… [whispers] ហើយកុំនិយាយខ្លាំងៗ។
files.subtitleEn: This is as far as I go. Follow the path to the funeral tent. Stay quiet.
